deviations_and_clarifications: Calibration map: the protocol (section 4.2) specifies a logistic (Platt) map; this is the decisive one. An isotonic map (requested in the task brief) is reported as supplementary only, never used for the decision.
Platt/isotonic maps are fitted on inner out-of-fold scores of the training diseases of each outer fold (nested grouped CV).
Random baseline: exact expectations (AUC 0.5, precision@k = positives/N, recall@20 = 20/N), no sampling.
Popularity counts all records up to the retrieval date (primary) or PUB_YEAR <= 2018 (temporal); the primary literature is restricted to <= 2024, a negligible mismatch.
Popularity expectation uses all Europe PMC records as the denominator while co-mention is measured in abstracts; the learned weight absorbs the constant.
Gene presence in a paper is a case-sensitive whole-word match of the HGNC symbol in title or abstract.
known_limits: Benchmark of 17 diseases: bootstrap intervals are wide.
Gold 1 is incomplete and partly circular.
Gold 2 is a name match in intervention fields and may include comparators.
PrimeKG-based gold may reflect post-2018 knowledge; the prior is excluded from the temporal analysis.

temporal_gold2.note: Literature up to 2018 only; knowledge-graph prior excluded, so only arms B and D are valid; arms A and C are not computed. Diseases with no gold 2 drug are excluded.

sensitivity_min_10_retrieved_papers.label: SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS (not the pre-registered primary analysis): diseases with >= 10 retrieved primary papers; the whole cross-validation is re-run on this subset
